source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Representing Relationships Using Predicates (PDF 32-33, printed 28-29).

blocks.text: Predicates asal duniya ki cheezon ke darmiyan rishte dikha sakte hain. Maslan Borrows(x, y) ka matlab hai “student x kitab y leta (borrow karta) hai,” aur Teaches(t, s) ka matlab hai “teacher t student s ko parhata hai.” Yeh predicates saaf batate hain ke students, kitabein aur teachers aapas mein kaise jure hain. Aise rishton se hum library system ke kaam ka model bana sakte hain. Is se mukhtalif entities (cheezon ya logon) ke darmiyan len den ko tarteeb dena aur samajhna aasan hota hai.

items: Borrows(x, y): student x kitab y leta hai; Teaches(t, s): teacher t student s ko parhata hai.
